title: Self-Aware Knowledge Probing: Evaluating Language Models' Relational Knowledge through Confidence Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2601.18901v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Knowledge probing quantifies how much relational knowledge a language model (LM) has acquired during pre-training. Existing knowledge probes evaluate model capabilities through metrics like prediction accuracy and precision. Such evaluations fail to account for the model's reliability, reflected in the calibration of its confidence scores. In this paper, we establish an empirical framework to evaluate the calibration of relational knowledge in a closed answer-set setting. We cover three modalities of model confidence: (1) intrinsic confidence, (2) paraphrase consistency and (3) linguistic confidence. Our extensive analysis of 21 causal and 8 masked language models reveals that most models, but especially those pre-trained with the masking objective, are overconfident. translated_title: 自我感知知识探测：通过置信度校准评估语言模型的关系知识
translated_abstract: 知识探测量化了语言模型（LM）在预训练期间获取的关系知识量。现有的知识探测方法通过预测准确率和精确率等指标来评估模型能力。此类评估未能考虑模型的可靠性，而可靠性体现在其置信度分数的校准中。在本文中，我们建立了一个实证框架，用于在封闭答案集设置下评估关系知识的置信度校准。我们涵盖了模型置信度的三种模态：（1）内在置信度、（2）释义一致性和（3）语言置信度。我们对21个因果语言模型和8个掩码语言模型的广泛分析表明，大多数模型——尤其是使用掩码目标预训练的模型——都存在过度自信的问题。校准效果最好的分数来自那些考虑了因语句改写而导致不一致性的置信度估计。此外，当增加t（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文建立了一个评估语言模型关系知识置信度校准的实证框架，发现大多数语言模型（尤其是掩码语言模型）存在过度自信问题，而考虑释义一致性的置信度估计能提供最佳的校准效果。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes an empirical framework for evaluating the confidence calibration of language models' relational knowledge, revealing that most models—especially masked language models—are overconfident, and that confidence estimates accounting for paraphrase consistency yield the best calibration.
